nodes.description: Private constant bytes32 guard marker keccak256("guard.bytes32") used to initialize the guard state variable.
Address of the external library contract invoked through delegatecall; set once in the constructor but stored in mutable storage.
bytes32 guard variable initialized to GUARD_VALUE and used as the require condition in batchLogs.
Public mapping of beneficiary address to UnlockSchedule arrays holding vesting schedules.
Constructor that stores the batcher library address and sets guard to GUARD_VALUE.
Public function that checks the guard, delegatecalls the batcher library with the supplied logs, then emits BatchLogs.
Caller-supplied bytes payload passed into the delegatecall encoder in batchLogs.
Caller-supplied bytes32 hash emitted in the BatchLogs event by batchLogs.
Constructor parameter holding the address written into gatedLogBatcherLib.
delegatecall to gatedLogBatcherLib with multiSend(bytes) selector, executing untrusted library code in the context of this contract.
Boolean success flag returned by the delegatecall in batchLogs.
Bytes return data produced by the delegatecall in batchLogs.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib is assigned to the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
Constant GUARD_VALUE is written into the guard state variable during construction.
Constructor writes the delegatecall target address gatedLogBatcherLib.
Constructor initializes the guard state variable.
batchLogs execution is gated by require(guard != GUARD_VALUE) reading the guard state variable.
User-supplied logs bytes are ABI-encoded into the delegatecall payload.
The delegatecall target is the mutable gatedLogBatcherLib storage address, allowing privileged/untrusted code execution in contract context.
batchLogs unconditionally reaches the delegatecall after the guard check.
The delegatecall return value defines the success local variable.
The delegatecall return payload defines the data local variable.
The delegatecall executes external library code in this contract's context and can re-enter batchLogs before the BatchLogs event is emitted.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter logs is only consumed by the delegatecall payload encoding in batchLogs, so it is normalized into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter contentHash is only used by the BatchLogs event inside batchLogs, so it is normalized into the enclosing function.
Constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib only feeds the state variable assignment in the constructor, so it is normalized into the constructor.
Local variable success is purely the delegatecall success flag and is normalized into the delegatecall operation.
Local variable data is purely the delegatecall return payload and is normalized into the delegatecall operation.
